My story feels like a story of destiny, love, and heartbreak.

In Class 4, I first heard his name. In Class 7, I noticed him for the first time when he scored 83 in Science. I still didn't care much about him then. But slowly, after some time, I started noticing him more and more, and eventually, I fell in love with him.

In Class 8, I proposed to him, and we got into a relationship. But his parents found out, and after just one week, we broke up.

That first heartbreak really hurt me. He had promised that he would always be my best friend, but then came the silence. He stopped talking to me. Still, my feelings never really went away. Somehow, I kept loving him more.

Then came Class 10. We had a common friend who knew how much I still loved him. He told him that he shouldn't stay away from me over one small matter, because he knew that we both still loved each other. Eventually, we found our way back to each other.

We became one of those couples everyone knew about. We were both good in studies, our behavior was good, and we supported each other. But then our parents found out too. We had to go through a full one-month breakup because of everything that happened. It was painful, but somehow, we found our way back to each other again.

Even our teachers eventually found out. At first, they were angry, but when they saw that our marks were actually improving and that we were still doing well in our tests, they slowly became happy for us.

After our HSLC, I ranked 8th in my school and he ranked 5th. We had grown together, supported each other, and achieved so much side by side.

But then life changed. Our goals became different, distance grew between us, and misunderstandings started hurting us. Slowly, the relationship became more painful than peaceful.

So this time, I was the one who chose to leave.

Two relationships. Two heartbreaks. Two versions of myself.

I don't know whether it was destiny that brought us together twice, or destiny that eventually taught me to let go. But I know that some people become a beautiful part of your story even if they don't remain a part of your future.

Maybe that was what our story was meant to be. ❤️

I’ve been listening to these mashup songs for the longest time, probably 2–3 years. And every time I read the comments about people’s love stories, I used to wonder:

“Will I ever have a story like this?” 🥹

Well… somehow, I do now. ❤️

My story actually started years ago.

I changed my school in 9th standard, and I also changed my coaching. There was this one boy who had a crush on me from 9th. He never confessed, though. I knew about it, but honestly, I didn’t want a relationship or anything like that, so I simply ignored it.

We spent almost two years in the same coaching, knowing about each other but never really saying anything.

Then 10th ended. Our paths separated after the boards, and during our last meeting, we just shook hands. Before leaving, he asked me, “When will we meet again?”

And I said, “I don’t know… maybe if some coincidence happens.”

And then… nothing.

For around one and a half years, we had absolutely no contact. I genuinely forgot about him. 🌙

Then, about three months ago, I finally made an Instagram account. Somehow, he found me and messaged me. I accepted because obviously, I knew him.

We started talking again. Just normal conversations at first.

Then one day I told him, “I never told you this, but I knew you had a crush on me.”

He said, “Yeah, I did. But I still have a crush on you.”

I asked him, “After almost two years? We haven’t even met.”

And then he said something I genuinely didn’t expect:

“It’s not a crush anymore. I love you.” 🥹❤️

I was like… BRO, ARE YOU SERIOUS?

I wasn’t ready for a relationship. I told him we would have to deal with long distance and that it wouldn’t be easy.

And I asked him three different times, “But how can this work?”

Every single time, his answer was basically:

“There is something called loyalty.”

He told me he could stay loyal to me for a lifetime.

And honestly… that broke through all my walls. ❤️‍🩹

Because someone had apparently carried those feelings for years without even knowing where I was, whether I would ever come back into his life, or whether I would ever feel the same.

So eventually, I said yes. ❤️
